name: Mbeki Healthcare
tagline: A nurse-practitioner practice in Kuils River and King William's Town
summary: A healthcare website that explains every service in plain language and makes booking an appointment simple.
location: Kuils River, Cape Town and King William's Town

paras: Mbeki Healthcare is a nurse-practitioner practice led by Sr Phindie Mbeki, with primary healthcare in Kuils River and a wellness and aesthetics branch in King William's Town. Patients needed one trustworthy place to see what the practice offers, which branch to visit and how to book.
Lead with trust and clarity. Every service gets its own plain-language page, both branches are clearly separated, and booking is never more than one tap away, by form or WhatsApp.

items: A mobile-first website with 18 service pages, from chronic care and family planning to wound care and IV drips
Separate branch and area pages for Kuils River, King William's Town and surrounding suburbs
An appointment booking form and WhatsApp booking
A Google review helper that copies the patient's words and opens the review page
A page for the practice's Phindi Naturals product range
Hosting, SSL and business email, managed by Digitalx
Patients can find the right service and branch and book online or on WhatsApp
Payment options, emergency contact and opening details are visible on every device
The site is maintained by Digitalx, so information stays current

name: Mbeki Healthcare Clinic System
tagline: Custom clinic software, built and managed by Digitalx
summary: A secure clinic administration system with one record per patient, from the front desk to the consulting room.

paras: The practice needed one secure place to run the clinic, from registering patients at the front desk to clinical notes and consent in the consulting room, without expensive off-the-shelf software.
Give every role its own station. Everything the front desk records is available to the nurse, but nothing clinical travels the other way, and every access to a patient record is logged.

items: One record per patient, from arrival to departure
Separate stations for the front desk, nurses and the practice administrator
Allergies, notes, diagnoses and medication hidden from the front desk
A log of every access to patient information
Document and PDF generation, and an installable app for staff
Front desk, consulting room and consent handled in one system
Clinical information protected by role-based access
A full record of who accessed patient information

name: TechStep Academy
tagline: Practical computer and technology training, Blackheath, Cape Town
summary: A course website that helps learners find their level, see every price and register or enrol on WhatsApp.

paras: TechStep Academy teaches practical computer and technology skills in five levels, from computer foundations to basic coding, for individuals and for company teams. Prospective learners needed to understand which level suits them, what it costs and how to start.

Make the learning path obvious. Each level has a clear outcome and a published price, a short "find your level" tool removes the guesswork, and enrolment works the way people already communicate: online or on WhatsApp.

items: Programme, course and pricing pages for all five levels and the full pathway
A "find your level" tool and online registration
Instalment options explained up front: a deposit plus monthly payments
A refer-and-earn page and a downloadable company profile
Location pages for learners across all nine provinces
Hosting and ongoing management by Digitalx
Learners can choose a level, see the price and register without phoning first
Companies can find on-site team training in the same place
Every course and location has its own page for search

name: VisaEase
tagline: Independent visa application support for South Africans
summary: A clear, trustworthy website for a visa support service that explains the process and books consultations.

paras: VisaEase helps South African applicants with US DS-160 forms, US embassy appointment scheduling and Schengen visa documents. Visa help is a trust purchase: people need to know exactly what the service does, and what it cannot promise, before they share personal details.
Be transparent first. Each service has its own page, the process is shown in four simple steps, and the site states plainly that VisaEase is independent and cannot guarantee a visa decision.

items: Dedicated pages for DS-160 support, US appointment scheduling and Schengen document preparation
A four-step "how it works" explanation
Consultation and contact calls to action on every page
Privacy policy and terms pages
Hosting and ongoing management by Digitalx
First-time applicants, business travellers and families can see which service fits them
Expectations are set honestly before anyone gets in touch
Every service is reachable from search through its own page

name: Unique Holistic Massage & Wellness Spa
tagline: Massage and wellness spa in Belgravia, Bellville
summary: A calm spa website with a full price list, mobile massage across Cape Town and online booking.

paras: Unique Holistic offers massage, lashes and nails, waxing, body scrubs, sauna and more from its Bellville spa, plus mobile massage across Cape Town. Clients wanted to see treatments and prices and book quickly, often from their phones.
Wellness is chosen on feel, then on price. A calm design sets the tone, the full price list is easy to find, and a sticky call, WhatsApp and book bar keeps booking within reach on every screen.

items: Treatment, pricing, mobile massage and team pages
Online booking through Fresha, plus call and WhatsApp options
Area pages for the Northern Suburbs
FAQs, opening hours and directions
Hosting and ongoing management by Digitalx
Clients can compare treatments and prices and book online in a few taps
Mobile massage, with its travel fee, is explained before anyone asks
Local area pages help the spa appear in nearby searches

name: Delight Aluminum Glass and Steel
tagline: Aluminium windows and doors, steel gates and glass, Cape Town
summary: A product-led website for an aluminium, glass and steel manufacturer that turns visitors into quote requests.

paras: Delight makes and installs custom aluminium windows and doors, trellis doors, steel gates and glass for homes, developers and businesses in the Western Cape. Buyers want to see the products and past work, then get a price.
Fabrication is bought on proof of work. Each product has its own page, the gallery shows completed installations, and requesting a quote is the easiest action on the site.

items: A page for each product line
A project gallery
A quote form with a service picker that sends the request straight to WhatsApp
A floating WhatsApp button, FAQs and service-area pages
Hosting and ongoing management by Digitalx
Visitors can browse products, see real installations and request a quote in under a minute
Quote requests arrive on WhatsApp with the product already chosen
Each product and service area has its own page for search

name: Kelvin Tadiwanashe
tagline: Author of "This Is Our Country: Between Memory and Tomorrow", now launched
summary: An author website for Kelvin Tadiwanashe, "The Royal Doctor": the launched debut book, the press around it and the author's own words.

paras: Kelvin Tadiwanashe, a Zimbabwean author, needed a home for his debut book, "This Is Our Country: Between Memory and Tomorrow", ahead of its launch: somewhere readers, press and the publisher could point to.

Put the book first, then let the author speak. After the launch we rebuilt the site in an editorial style: a cinematic cover hero, the book's three themes, press coverage and quotes in Kelvin's own words, with "Get the book" always one tap away.

items: An editorial homepage: the launched book, "In the news", "In his own words" and a photo journey
The book's three threads (History & Memory, Leadership and Zimbabwean Identity) told as short sections
"Get the book" calls to action linking to the publisher
About, book, blog and contact pages, plus a photo gallery with a lightbox
The site now announces the launched book and sends readers straight to buy it
Press coverage, quotes and launch photos sit together, ready for media and event organisers

name: SANA: Safe and Noble Actions
tagline: Road-safety awareness for South Africa, a Digitalx initiative
summary: Digitalx's own road-safety initiative: plain-language safety topics, tips and campaigns that anyone can share.

paras: Road-safety advice is often long, technical and easy to ignore. As our own community initiative, SANA needed a simple, memorable home for practical guidance that anyone can act on and share.
Short topics, one-line tips and a clear invitation to get involved, built around the tagline "Every trip. Every driver. Every time."

items: Eight road-safety topic pages, from speeding and drunk driving to fatigue and pedestrian awareness
Shareable safety tips and a campaigns section
Free resources to download
Get-involved paths for individuals, businesses, schools and communities
A free public resource that schools, businesses and drivers can use and share
A home for SANA campaigns as they launch

name: GetClient
tagline: South Africa's verified business directory, built by Digitalx
summary: Our own product: "Hire local. Hire checked." A directory of South African businesses that passed identity and CIPC checks, with the checks shown on every profile.

paras: People searching for a service provider struggle to tell real, registered businesses from the rest. Good businesses, in turn, struggle to prove they are trustworthy. GetClient is Digitalx's answer to both.
Verification first, shown in the open. Every profile lists which checks it passed and when; checks expire after 12 months and are re-run, so a badge never goes stale.

items: Search by business, category and city, plus location and category pages
Up to five checks per profile: identity, CIPC registration, insurance, trading history and client ratings
Free listings and paid Blue and Gold verification tiers, with public pricing
"Listed on GetClient" badges that businesses add to their own sites with one line of code
Quote requests, and a light and dark theme
An installable web app
A live directory where people find checked businesses and request quotes
Verified businesses show their badge on their own websites, as Digitalx and several of our clients do
